turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If tracking never updates, the available guidance is to first re-check the shipping confirmation and the master tracking link, because large orders can ship in multiple boxes with additional associated shipments.
If there’s still no usable second tracking link or the shipment is not updating, contact customer care at info@onefastcat.com or 844-335-8858 for help reviewing it.
If you want, I can also help with general shipping policy questions here.

How do I find my tracking link?
Your tracking link is sent in the shipping confirmation email once the order has been packed and a shipping label has been created. If your order shipped in more than one box, that email may also include a master tracking link with additional associated shipments.
If you can’t find it, check your inbox for the shipping confirmation email and review that tracking link again. If it still isn’t there, contact customer care at info@onefastcat.com or 844-335-8858.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
by contacting customer care.
If a tracking number already exists, One Fast Cat can request a FedEx address correction for a $17 flat fee paid by the customer. FedEx does not guarantee the change, though the policy says it is usually successful.
If you do not want to pay the fee, the no-fee option listed is to ask FedEx to hold the package for pickup at a nearby location. Once an item is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed.
Policy page: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes
